      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Load the data (in Colab, use file upload method)\n",
        "df = pd.read_excel('/content/SupplyFlow FMCG Solutions.xlsx')"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "RNblkkebHJb0"
      },
      "execution_count": 2,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Handle missing values\n",
        "df['workers_num'].fillna(df['workers_num'].median(), inplace=True)\n",
        "df['approved_wh_govt_certificate'] = df['approved_wh_govt_certificate'].map({'A+':4, 'A':3, 'B':2, 'C':1}).fillna(0)\n",
        "df['wh_est_year'].fillna(df['wh_est_year'].median(), inplace=True)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "XK0BeBFiHV7f",
        "outputId": "d4500da1-0f8a-4b95-fd53-8956f8e0b096"

            "\n",
            "\n",
            "  df['wh_est_year'].fillna(df['wh_est_year'].median(), inplace=True)\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# 📊 Correlation Heatmap\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(16,10))\n",
        "sns.heatmap(df.select_dtypes(include=['float64', 'int64']).corr(), annot=True, fmt=\".2f\", cmap=\"coolwarm\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Correlation Matrix of Warehouse Features\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 722
        },
        "id": "u7v-oWQVHcy8",
        "outputId": "92a3a875-35ce-4e30-f460-6fc9238b678f"
      },
      "execution_count": 4,

    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "zx3XlLmfHkBT"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# 🚨 Identify Underperforming Warehouses\n",
        "low_output_threshold = df['product_wg_ton'].quantile(0.25)\n",
        "df['issue_score'] = df['num_refill_req_l3m'] + df['transport_issue_l1y'] + df['storage_issue_reported_l3m'] + df['wh_breakdown_l3m']\n",
        "\n",
        "underperforming = df[(df['product_wg_ton'] <= low_output_threshold) | (df['issue_score'] >= 2)]"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "tbRqU9ljHlSN"
      },
      "execution_count": 5,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# 🔍 Zone-wise Summary\n",
        "summary = underperforming.groupby('zone').agg({\n",
        "    'product_wg_ton': 'mean',\n",
        "    'issue_score': 'mean',\n",
        "    'workers_num': 'mean'\n",
        "}).reset_index()\n",
        "print(summary)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "TJRH8RNgHpXq",
        "outputId": "9fdfc646-199b-43cd-e045-397811dca87c"
      },
      "execution_count": 6,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "    zone  product_wg_ton  issue_score  workers_num\n",
            "0   East    22721.452214    26.095571    29.198135\n",
            "1  North    22199.437926    25.512065    28.888889\n",
            "2  South    21933.495913    25.318453    28.855549\n",
            "3   West    22079.384189    25.519607    28.955995\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# 📈 Visualize Zone-wise Issues\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))\n",
        "sns.barplot(data=summary, x='zone', y='issue_score', palette='Reds')\n",
        "plt.title('Average Issue Score by Zone (Underperforming Warehouses)')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Avg Issue Score')\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
